text: Hey, what’s that Pokémon in front of you?!\nIt looks SUPER strong![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice1_rival_02
text: Kinda seems like it’s waiting for you...\nDoes it want you to follow it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice2_rival_02
text: That Pokémon might be as strong as mine!\nMaybe stronger![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice3_rival_01
text: Hey, heads up—some pretty rough and rowdy\nHoundour live in this cave![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice3_rival_02
text: I’m glad you’ve got your bodyguard, but watch\nyour back! They’re strong![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice4_rival_01
text: Oh my gosh, it straight up pulverized that rock!\nHow powerful even IS it?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0140_voice4_rival_02
text: I wonder what that move was. Man, I wanna\nsee it up close![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
